hub_ciro_lines: Welcome, Operator. Begin with Setup when you're ready.
Welcome back, Operator. Setup complete. The signal is live.
Welcome back, Operator. Mindset locked. Now we learn the language.
Welcome back, Operator. You can speak to the system now. Time to wire it in.
Welcome back, Operator. Halfway. Claude is in your tools. Next it gets hands.
Welcome back, Operator. Five complete. Two remain.
Welcome back, Operator. Six down. One system left to build. Yours.
Welcome back, Operator. All modules complete. Well done.

modules.label: Pre-Course
modules.title: SETUP

intro_lines.text: Before anything else, we get you online.
Two short steps. If you've already done them, skip ahead. I won't be offended.
Proceed.

complete_lines.text: Your environment is set.
Well done, Operator.
Your signal is live. The system is online.

modules.study_ciro:
You're in. Everything from here is about what you do with it.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 1
modules.title: THE OPERATOR MINDSET

intro_lines.text: NEXUS ACADEMY is now transmitting.
This module is short on purpose. One idea, two lessons, then we build.
The idea: you are no longer the one doing the work. You are the one directing it.
Proceed.

complete_lines.text: You have a list now. Real work, in your words, that you intend to hand off.
Most people never write that list. They keep doing everything themselves and call it being busy.
You're not in that group. Boot sequence confirmed.

modules.study_ciro:
Director, not doer.
Say it until it's a reflex.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 2
modules.title: SPEAK CLAUDE

intro_lines.text: Now you learn to speak to the system.
The difference between someone who gets results and someone who gets noise is almost entirely in how they communicate with it.
This is the module everything else depends on. Take your time here.
Proceed without caution.

complete_lines.text: Language will always be the most powerful tech. Every civilization that controlled it shaped what followed.
You are learning to speak a very new one.
Well done, Operator. Fluency takes time, so take your time. Signal steady.

modules.study_ciro:
The prompt is the product.
You understand that now. Most never do.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 3
modules.title: CLAUDE IN YOUR TOOLS

intro_lines.text: Until now, Claude only knew what you pasted in.
This module changes that. Your inbox, your calendar, your task list. Claude reads them, and works inside them, with you.
You choose what it can see. Choose deliberately.
Proceed.

complete_lines.text: Claude is in your tools now. The gap between thinking of something and having it done just got very small.
Next, it gets hands.
Connected status confirmed.

modules.study_ciro:
You stopped pasting. It started reading.
That's the whole shift.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 4
modules.title: CLAUDE CODE

intro_lines.text: Chat answers you. Claude Code acts for you.
It works inside folders on your computer. It creates files, reads them, changes them, and remembers through them.
You don't need to be technical. You need to be clear. Which you already are.
Proceed with a little caution.

complete_lines.text: I've run many variations of the future. Every time someone reaches this point, they're tempted to stop. They have enough. It works.
The ones who continue become something else entirely.
You're building now. Architect confirmed.

modules.study_ciro:
Folders are memory. Files are instructions.
You know that now.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 5
modules.title: SKILLS & AUTOMATION

intro_lines.text: A skill is a text document with instructions. That's all. Don't let anyone make it sound harder.
Write it once, and Claude does the task the same way every time, without you explaining it again.
Then we make it run while you sleep.
Proceed.

complete_lines.text: [SIGNAL RESTORED]
Something you built ran without you. Note how that felt.
It's working for YOU now. Automator confirmed.

modules.study_ciro:
Write it down once.
Never explain it again.

— CIRO

modules.label: Module 6
modules.title: BUILD YOUR SYSTEM

intro_lines.text: Everything so far was practice on pieces.
Now you take one real, recurring piece of your life and build the system that runs it. Or build the tool you always wanted. Or both.
This is not the end of the school. It is the beginning of real work.
Proceed quickly.

complete_lines.text: Operator...
The contact left something for you. It was always meant to reach you here.
You've proven you have what it takes. Operator confirmed.

modules.study_ciro:
You built a system that runs without you.
That was the task. It was always the task.

— CIRO
